title: Augmenting Text to Increase Translation Difficulty
abstract: arXiv:2608.15932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As state-of-the-art machine translation models saturate standard benchmarks, the field needs more challenging evaluations to distinguish between models of varying quality. We propose augmenting existing benchmarks to increase translation difficulty by combining adversarial optimization with a differentiable translation difficulty estimator. Our Adversarial Translation Optimization (ATO) uses gradients from a combined difficulty and fluency objective to iteratively replace tokens. Because each step branches over candidate substitutions at every position, optimization becomes a tree search problem, which we address with Beam Search. ATO offers a gradient-based alternative to LLM-based dataset creation without LLM prompting, expensive human curation, or task-specific model training. Our ATO-modified benchmark lowers average translation quality (xCOMET) from 0.93 to 0.82, compared to 0.88 for paraphrasing and 0.86 for a zero-shot baseline. H

translated_title: 增强文本以提升翻译难度
translated_abstract: 随着最先进的机器翻译模型在标准基准测试上趋于饱和，该领域需要更具挑战性的评估来区分不同质量的模型。我们提出通过结合对抗性优化和可微分的翻译难度估计器，增强现有基准以提升翻译难度。我们的对抗性翻译优化（ATO）利用来自组合难度和流畅性目标的梯度，迭代地替换词汇。由于每一步都会在每个位置上对候选替换进行分支，优化变成了一个树搜索问题，我们使用束搜索来解决。ATO提供了一种基于梯度的替代方案，用于基于LLM的数据集创建，无需LLM提示、昂贵的人工筛选或特定任务的模型训练。我们修改后的ATO基准将平均翻译质量（xCOMET）从0.93降至0.82，而释义基线为0.88，零样本基线为0.86。
tldr: 提出一种基于梯度的对抗性优化方法，通过束搜索迭代替换词汇来提升翻译难度，无需人工或LLM提示，有效降低基准翻译质量以更好区分模型性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a gradient-based adversarial optimization method using beam search to iteratively replace tokens, increasing translation difficulty without human or LLM prompting, effectively lowering benchmark quality to better distinguish model performance.
